svg.aria-label: Static MIPA overview: a dense dataset is distilled into a small synthetic set; real and synthetic images flow through shared augmentations and a frozen encoder into prototype assignments, the joint distribution sharpens, and gradients update only the synthetic pixels
svg.title: Static MIPA overview: a dense dataset is distilled into a small synthetic set; real and synthetic images flow through shared augmentations and a frozen encoder into prototype assignments, the joint distribution sharpens, and gradients update only the synthetic pixels
svg.text: The teacher is frozen; only the synthetic pixels learn.

g.text: gradient ascent on the synthetic pixels (Adam)
